name: agent-waste-firewall
description: AWF is a local-first live monitor, prompt coach, and no-progress circuit breaker for coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Monitor coding agents and catch no-progress loops.
interface.longDescription: Checks instructions before execution, detects repeated work without repository progress, records strict anonymized semantic traces, and powers a local live dashboard with prompt coaching.
defaultPrompt: Show the latest waste incidents and suggest a stronger task prompt.
